(2) The cats move with a rhythmic, bouncing gait, as if dancing in a parade. In the background and around them, several large firecrackers are being detonated, sending plumes of smoke and sparks into the air. The lead cats have focused expressions and are holding poles with their paws. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows on the ground littered with colorful confetti. The yellow uniforms feature large black Chinese characters on the chest.
